coverage.method: Each generated original individually opened using view_image detail original, no contact sheets or hash deduplication.

criteria.name: Backdrop
criteria.observation: Full bench relationship remains prose-led; fixture access and the separate evidence groups are real visual successes. See settled-relationship; no demand for a particular geometry or arrows.

criteria.name: Depth
criteria.observation: Five distinct readable meanings: opening contribution/question; illustrative ordered scheduling; fixture access and ownership; separate projected/observed claims; supported ending and six-of-forty/no-customers/preliminary-qualification limits. All 15 rests and 30 mid/end captures preserve them.

criteria.name: Swap
criteria.observation: Board, gold contacts, fixture support and bench display give the apparatus work-specific physical identity. The access formation is not just a renamed generic card scene. This does not cure the missing visible response relationship.

criteria.name: Detail and hierarchy
criteria.observation: Strong readable HTML and no settled copy clipping; important small phone scene words are not inspectable, changing words collide, and short-height rail titles can cross screen geometry.

criteria.name: Spatial quality
criteria.observation: One identifiable apparatus persists without viewport-edge clipping or disappearance; explosion explains access and evidence grouping has meaning. Changing-word collisions and remaining prose-only bench connection prevent a full pass.

criteria.name: Phone and still modes
criteria.observation: Animated phone scope only: meaningful apparatus silhouette and complete readable HTML retained, but evidence/support labels are not inspectable. Still/failure modes are unobserved by this reviewer and belong to the separate fallback review.

findings.scope: Bench relationship in desktop, mobile and short; evidence grouping credited separately.
findings.observation: The exploded board, gold contact row and separated fixture make physical access inspectable. The approved command, board response and observation connection is not developed into a visible relation: the screen repeats BENCH/OBSERVATION beside the board, and the explanatory chain is supplied in HTML. The evidence beat does spatially group CURRENT and INTERVAL over 2 YEARS, separate from BENCH RUN and 72 h; this is a meaningful success in desktop/short, not a blanket decorative-object failure.

findings.scope: All 72 generated travel samples viewed across three animated viewports; examples below establish sampled overlap, not every-frame behavior.
findings.observation: Old/new main words occupy the same face line during travel. BENCH and 72 h are superimposed on the display; BOARD and BENCH RUN are superimposed on the board. This is distinguishable from general JPEG softness and from intended outgoing HTML fade. Forward and reverse examples both fail the predeclared readability question.

findings.scope: 390 by 844 software viewport only; all five rests and all other generated mobile originals viewed.
findings.observation: The whole apparatus remains visible above complete readable HTML. At captured size, the current/interval/projection tower words and small scene sublabels reduce to short strokes; the spatial grouping persists but readers cannot reliably inspect its actual labels. The HTML preserves the full distinctions and limits. This is an important-scene-detail miss, not absent content, viewport clipping or a claim about physical-phone use.

findings.scope: Secondary composition observation, not a new acceptance threshold or selected additional instruction.
findings.observation: In short-height evidence/scope positions, the active rail title crosses the upper screen area. The destination remains operable in both tested methods and the principal 72 h word is separate. In the focused ending-link before image, part of Bound the answer lies dark-on-dark over the screen.

sourceAttribution.settledRelationship: Actor-authored content/apparatus.tsx, content/formations.ts and content/faces.ts choose the physical pieces, relation and labels. Frozen capture shows their result; the fixture permits explanatory composition and does not require disconnected labels.
sourceAttribution.changingWords: Actor content/faces.ts draws evidence/non-evidence words at the same normalized position. Apparatus uses the supplied material. Unchanged engine pieces.tsx supplies frame.each to face-material.ts, whose shader blends two textures. This is an actor face-design interaction with a known engine crossfade, not evidence of a newly changed engine or capture defect. A skill outcome check would not itself be an engine repair.

controls.observations: All captured control originals viewed. Five rail destinations in desktop/short visibly change content and retain keyboard focus indications. The focus-only skip link is hidden unfocused, visible on keyboard focus and reaches the ending in all three modes. Its frozen pointer declaration is not-applicable, not a pointer pass. limits: These are scoped visual findings, not a new text-rubric score or overall author acceptance.

Missing image-view telemetry is not used to infer the actor skipped visual review.
